Welcome to your perfectly located oasis at THE LAGUNA! Spend some time outside in the spacious backyard swimming, barbecuing, or playing mini golf. Lots of great hiking/biking trails nearby.

Purposefully and functionally designed for Airbnb guests. Every detail was meticulously thought out by vacation rental designers and Airbnb Superhosts Reed and Crystal.

"THE LAGUNA" is an exclusive Scottsdale vacation home that includes a sparkling pebble tech heated pool & every other amenity that you could want! Feel like you have an entire resort just to yourself! No expense was sparred while creating this newly renovated mid century property with a resort inspired backyard.

Decorating provided by Pink Pony Bachelorette DOT COM. Decorations do not come with the house. The decor portrays what the house can look like when decorated by our exclusive decorating partner Pink Pony Bach. When you book this property you will receive 10% all decorating and service packages with Pink Pony Bachelorette. We will provide you the 10% off promo code after booking.

We deep clean and update the furniture regularly. We use new linens, pillows, comforters, duvet covers as often as needed to keep everything clean and fresh. We clean the upholstery monthly to keep our property in tip top shape. We have no carpet in the home besides area rugs to be more sanitary and keep things sparkling clean.

This home is very close to Old Town Scottsdale. You'll be minutes away from the best restaurants, nightlife, world-class golf courses, hiking trails, and highly regarded shopping malls such as Fashion Square Mall.

*Pool heating will be billed after booking & for the ENTIRE STAY.
*Pool does not need to be heated mid to late May through mid September.
*Pool is serviced twice weekly. Usually Sundays/Mondays & Thursdays/Fridays.
(Times subject to change)

Scottsdale has adopted a new noise ordinance to help protect the neighbors and neighborhood from unruly/loud vacation rental properties. This ordinance shall pertain to any and all properties located in Scottsdale, AZ. In effect if the police are called for nuisance party or noise disturbance up to a $2,500 fine could be assessed to the guests. If this happens you will be charged for the fine. Please keep the noise levels down and respect the neighbors. Thank you for your understanding.
